Test signature help lists all overloads at a call.

-- o.go --
package overload

func add(int) int { return 0 }
func add(int64) int64 { return 0 }

type S struct{}
func (S) m(int) int { return 0 }
func (S) m(int64) int64 { return 0 }

func _() {
	_ = add(0) //@overloadsignatures("(", "add(int) int", "add(int64) int64")
	var s S
	_ = s.m(0) //@overloadsignatures("(", "m(int) int", "m(int64) int64")
}
